current_f2_fact: Interrupted VoiceOutputPacket may retain nonzero heard_fraction but is not commit-eligible unless playback completed and heard_fraction=1.0; current cited F2 source does not independently define interrupted-response ephemeral next-turn context retention.

recommended_policy_candidate.rule: Retain exactly measured heard prefix for ephemeral next-turn context; exclude unheard tail; leave durable memory, VoiceOutcome and effect admission separately gated.
